equations.background: D_nu=T67_nu−T67_throat>0; L_nu=pi+D_nu; Omega_nu²=(2pi/L_nu)². Positive flux weights sum to1. b0/alpha=pi*(meanOmega²−1)/6; c0=1/(3*b0/alpha).
equations.recurrence: jnu_plus−jnu_plus_L=c0*Qnu(A+A_L−B_D−B_pi), and plus/minus with A/B exchanged; Qnu=d²/dx²+Omega_nu². These j are deviations from the channel vacuum stress.
equations.evolution: (d³/dx³+d/dx)A=−sum(weights*jnu_plus)−p; (d³/dx³+d/dx)B=−sum(weights*jnu_minus). A,B and stress responses are divided by alpha; integrals of A/B are retained.
equations.carrier: p is an external small test carrier with area pi*1e−4/2, sin^4 profile and width .4. It crosses once and is removed; it is not injected once into every channel or subsequently recirculated. No physical preparation or new matter model is supplied.
equations.clocks: For x=s+pi/2: delta r=(integral A(x)−integral B(x−pi))/b0, delta l=(integral B(x)−integral A(x−pi))/b0, with normalized b0. The stored rates are1+their derivatives.
equations.transit: T_LR(s)=pi+delta l(s)−delta r(s+pi), T_RL(s)=pi+delta r(s)−delta l(s+pi), to first order only. The shortest complete return adds the fixed shortest exterior delay. Sampled entries require both endpoints inside the solved history.

verification.one_channel_check_status: not run after distributed convergence failure
verification.comparison: Common time samples of A/B jets, primitives, aggregate stress and real mouth-clock rates. The separate literal-old-source one-channel solve is skipped if distributed convergence fails; no skipped check is recorded as passed.

scope: Four shortest-loop times, small external pulse and a linear leading-pi-throat model only. The67 exterior delays/weights seed this new model; it is not full finite-collar dynamics and does not evolve angular geometry, the physical exterior, finite-q states or interface conditions. Long-delay channels may not complete one loop. Sampled positive clocks and linearized transit/return times are finite-run diagnostics, not exact nonlinear travel times, a global stability theorem, quantum-state preparation, formation or backward time travel.
sources: Our distributed extension of the existing retarded loop_return_checks recurrence; no new physical wormhole solution is asserted.
